blocks.text: Sab se ahem ghair makhsoos difa khoon ke jaraseem maar cells dete hain jo khoon mein gasht karte aur jaraseem par hamla kar ke maarte hain. In ki teen bunyadi qismein hain: macrophages, neutrophils aur natural killer cells.

items: Macrophages monocytes, safaid khoon ke cells ki aik qisam, se bante hain. Macrophage bacterium ko endocytosis se andar le kar apne enzymes se maarta hai. Kuch phephron, jigar, tilli aur dimagh jaise aaza mein jame hote hain, lekin zyada tar khoon, lymph aur interstitial mayi mein gasht karte hain.

Neutrophils, safaid khoon ke cells ki doosri qisam, jaraseem ko teen tareeqon se maarte hain: phagocytosis; jaraseem par ghulne wale jaraseem kush kimiyai maadde chhorna; aur DNA dhagon ka jaal chhorna jo bimari wale bacteria ko pakar kar maarta hai.

blocks.alt: Bara gulabi macrophage jis ki satah jhurridar aur aik lamba ubhaar hai, aas paas dande jaise bacteria; aik bacterium us ke kinare se andar liya ja raha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 21.4: Jaraseem par hamla karta macrophage (kitab ki tasveer, Figure 21.4, ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Oopar aik neutrophil, teen teer us ke teen tareeqon tak: phagocytosis (pathogen cell ki jeb mein), anti-microbial kimiyai maadde chhorna (daane pathogen par), aur reshon (fibres) ka jaal jo pathogen ko phansata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 21.5: Pathogens maarne ke liye neutrophils ke tareeqe (kitab ki Figure 21.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Neutrophil, Pathogen, Anti-microbial chemicals, Fibres, Phagocytosis, Release of anti-microbial chemicals, Generation of network of fibres.

blocks.text: Natural killer (NK) cells hamla awar jaraseem ko nahi maarte; yeh virus zada jismani cells ko pehchan kar un par hamla karte hain. Yeh perforins chhorte hain jo target cell ki membrane mein ghus kar soorakh banate hain; paani andar daurta aur cell phool kar phat jata hai. Yeh cancer cells ko bhi pehchan kar rasoli banne se pehle maar dete hain.

blocks.alt: Khoon ka germ-killer cell target cell se chipka hua. Perforins ka daana target ki taraf khulta hai, perforins tang faasla paar karte hain aur target cell ki membrane mein chhallon jaise pores banate hain. Neeche target cell ka nucleus.
blocks.caption: Figure 21.6: Infected cell par hamla karta natural killer cell (kitab ki Figure 21.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Perforins, Germ-Killer cell of blood, Target cell, Pore, Nucleus, Cell membrane of target cell (infected cells).

blocks.title: NK cells aur cytotoxic T cells
blocks.text: Kitab natural killer cells ko T-lymphocytes ki qisam aur cytotoxic T cells kehti hai. NK cells lymphocytes hain, lekin T cells se alag qisam ke cells hain: yeh ghair makhsoos difa ka hissa hain, jab ke cytotoxic T cells makhsoos immune jawab ka hissa hain (topic 21.3.2). Dono infected cells ko perforins ke zariye milte julte tareeqe se maarte hain.

blocks.title: Maloomat: self-proteins
blocks.text: Gasht karne wale cells jism ke apne cells par hamla nahi karte kyunke sab normal cells ki satah par pehchan ka protein nishan, self-protein, hota hai. Jaraseem maar cells sirf un cells par hamla karte hain jin mein yeh proteins na hon.

blocks.prompt: Natural killer cell infected cell ko kaise maarta hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh perforins chhorta hai jo infected cell ki membrane mein soorakh banate hain; paani andar daurta aur cell phool kar phat jata hai.

items: Macrophages (monocytes se) nigal kar hazam karte.
Neutrophils: phagocytosis, kimiyai maadde, DNA jaal.
NK cells perforins se virus zada aur cancer cells phaarte.
